description: This file implements a push-to-talk voice recognition feature for macOS, including hotkey monitoring, speech recognition management, and overlay UI updates.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: A singleton class that monitors right Option key presses to trigger push-to-talk speech recognition.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Actor managing speech recognition session during push-to-talk hotkey activation, including starting, handling results, and finalizing speech capture.

methods.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey.setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables monitoring for the hotkey.

methods.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey.startMonitoring
methods.description: Starts global and local event monitoring for key modifier flags changes.

methods.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey.handleFlagsChanged
methods.description: Handles the change in modifier flags, updates internal state, and triggers speech recognition start or stop.

methods.name: VoicePushToTalk.begin
methods.description: Starts voice recognition session, configuring speech recognizer and audio engine, and updates UI overlays.

methods.name: VoicePushToTalk.end
methods.description: Stops voice recognition, processes final transcript, updates overlays, and resets state.
